clue.text: Nonsense, it produces opium my old friend

parts.note: the opium poppy is the plant from which opium is drawn
'my old cock' is a dated British form of address to a pal

explanation.surface: Someone dismisses a claim about opium as rubbish while addressing a chum.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Old cock' is an old-fashioned British term of affection for a male friend.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are words for foolish talk or rubbish.

clue.text: Cricketer on the bottle?

definitions.meaning: a batsman who begins the innings
a gadget applied to a bottle to remove its cap

explanation.surface: A cricketer is suspected of drinking.
explanation.walkthrough: 'On the bottle' suggests drinking heavily; it is the tool used on a bottle top.
explanation.definitionFit: One of the first two batsmen in an innings; also a tool for removing bottle caps.

clue.text: Little Pamela to step on the plain in South America

parts.note: Pam is the short form of the name Pamela
pas is the French word for a dance step

explanation.surface: A girl dances across the grassland of Argentina.
explanation.definitionFit: The vast treeless grasslands of Argentina and Uruguay.

clue.text: Blue pencil of Roman magistrate

definitions.meaning: to cut objectionable material, as editors did with a blue pencil
an official of ancient Rome who kept the census and oversaw public morals

explanation.surface: A Roman official's colouring pencil.
explanation.definitionFit: To expurgate text; also an ancient Roman official in charge of morals and the census.

clue.text: Homework

parts.note: read not as school assignments but as paid work done at home

explanation.surface: Pupils' assignments set for the evening.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Homework' suggests school tasks; it is manufacturing carried out in workers' own houses.
explanation.definitionFit: Small-scale production carried on in people's own houses.

clue.text: The sun is an outstanding feature

definitions.meaning: a lamp up in the sky, a lofty source of illumination
the best or most memorable part

explanation.surface: Sunshine is the best part of the trip.
explanation.definitionFit: The sun is a lofty lamp in the sky; also the best part or most notable moment.

clue.text: I hit upon a poor place in Pakistan

parts.note: to slam is to strike hard
bad means of poor quality

explanation.surface: A visitor strikes a run-down town in Pakistan.
explanation.definitionFit: The capital city of Pakistan.

clue.text: Fruit failed to succeed when put in the ground, we hear

indicators.note: the clue signals that the words are spoken and the result sounds alike

parts.words: failed to succeed when put in the ground
parts.note: blew means failed (blew it) and bury means put in the ground, so the stretch gives blew then bury

explanation.surface: A crop did not take when planted.
explanation.walkthrough: BLEW (failed) followed by BURY ('to succeed' meaning come after) sounds like the berry.
explanation.definitionFit: A small dark-blue berry from a shrub.

clue.text: Lorry driver liable for duty

parts.note: the 'driver' is not a person but what powers a lorry, a fuel on which tax (duty) is charged

explanation.surface: A haulier finds himself owing tax.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Driver' suggests a person; here it is the fuel that drives the engine, and fuel duty is a UK tax.
explanation.definitionFit: Heavy goods vehicles run on this fuel, which carries excise duty.

clue.text: Develop German rowing crew, we hear

indicators.note: the clue signals that the phrase is spoken and the result is a word that sounds the same

parts.note: a rowing eight from Germany, a German eight

explanation.surface: A team of German oarsmen is getting better.
explanation.definitionFit: Seeds sprout and begin to grow, so the verb means start to develop.

clue.text: Sherpa relays a few words

indicators.note: to relay is to lay again, so the letters of the guide's name are laid out anew

explanation.surface: A Himalayan guide passes on a short message.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Relays' looks like passing on a message, but it signals the rearrangement of SHERPA.
explanation.definitionFit: A short group of words forming a unit of expression.

clue.text: Having a number of sides last month, one moved along

parts.note: December, abbreviated Dec, is the last month of the year
a means one

indicators.note: the word along is shifted about into a new order

explanation.surface: Something shuffled forward a month ago has many faces.
explanation.definitionFit: A decagon is a figure with ten sides, a particular number of them.

clue.text: Talk wildly about one mainly involved in theft

indicators.note: the chattering word goes around the numeral piece

parts.note: to prate is to chatter foolishly
the Roman numeral I is one

explanation.surface: Someone rants about a person caught up in stealing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mainly' puns on the Spanish Main, the sea: the thief works at sea.
explanation.definitionFit: A sea robber steals on the main, the high seas.

clue.text: Defeat with an extra run

definitions.meaning: to topple or bring down a ruler or government
in cricket, a run scored when a fielder's throw passes the stumps unchecked

explanation.surface: A team loses despite scoring a bonus run.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket, extra runs are scored when a fielder's return throw goes past the wicket.
explanation.definitionFit: To topple a regime; in cricket, a stray return giving bonus runs.

clue.text: You hear I slander a man from Reykjavik

indicators.note: the clue signals that the two words are spoken and sound like the result

parts.note: these words are said aloud, and what is heard is the sound this part of the answer needs

explanation.surface: Someone admits defaming a man from Iceland's capital.
explanation.definitionFit: Reykjavik is the capital of Iceland, so a native is a national of that country.

clue.text: Avoid emphasising it on the piano

definitions.meaning: to play down or downplay a matter
the left pedal of a piano, which quietens the sound

explanation.surface: A pianist plays a passage gently.
explanation.definitionFit: To play down; literally the piano pedal that mutes the tone.

clue.text: Clearing part of the meadow

indicators.note: only a portion of the word Clearing is taken, a run inside it

explanation.surface: A glade forms a section of the pasture.
explanation.definitionFit: A poetic word for grassland or pasture.

clue.text: Left you old alkaline solution

parts.note: ye is an archaic word for you

explanation.surface: An antique chemical has been abandoned.
explanation.definitionFit: A strong alkali solution used for cleaning and soap-making.

clue.text: Together with Dan performing

indicators.note: the name's letters are put through their paces, rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone appears on stage alongside a man named Dan.
explanation.definitionFit: A conjunction joining items, meaning plus or as well as.

clue.text: There is the prospect of success in aerial combat

definitions.text: There is the prospect of success in aerial combat

parts.words: There is the prospect of success in aerial combat
parts.note: a phrase meaning triumph seems imminent, read literally as winning a dogfight in the sky

explanation.surface: Pilots sense they are about to win a dogfight.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom says triumph is sensed coming, and literally places that win up among the clouds.

clue.text: Close finish

definitions.meaning: the close of something is its conclusion
a finish is the final part

explanation.surface: A tight conclusion to a race.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words mean the final point or conclusion.

clue.text: Render an account

parts.note: to give a narrative or tell a story of events

explanation.surface: Someone is asked to submit a bill.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Account' suggests a bill to settle, but it means a story told.
explanation.definitionFit: To narrate or recount events is to give an account of them.

clue.text: Most of a range of notes, nothing else for the book

indicators.note: all but the final letter of the musical span is taken

parts.note: an octave is a span of eight notes
O looks like zero, nothing

explanation.surface: A singer needs only most of their range for the volume.
explanation.definitionFit: A book size made by folding sheets into eight leaves.

clue.text: Prophet is first class and a hard leader

parts.note: A1 is first class, the 1 read as I

indicators.note: only the opening letter of the word hard is taken

explanation.surface: A tough-guy prophet is top-notch.
explanation.walkthrough: A1 means first-rate; the digit 1 stands in as the letter I.
explanation.definitionFit: An Old Testament prophet, with a book of the Bible named after him.

clue.text: Work out why

definitions.meaning: to think logically and deduce
the cause or explanation

explanation.surface: Someone asks for an explanation of the exercise.
explanation.definitionFit: To think a problem through logically; also the cause or motive behind something.

clue.text: Dance at a rapid pace

definitions.meaning: a fast ballroom dance in quick time
read literally as speedy footwork, fast steps

explanation.surface: Dancers move briskly across the floor.
explanation.definitionFit: A brisk ballroom dance; split, the words mean a fast stride.

clue.text: Have a longing for some consumer goods?

definitions.meaning: to crave or yearn
whimsically, a ... is what makes one consume goods, i.e. food

explanation.surface: A shopper yearns for things to buy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Consumer goods' suggests shopping; in the second reading the goods are food, consumed because of appetite.
explanation.definitionFit: Yearning and appetite both drive a person to eat, to consume.

clue.text: Coming from Stateside is most consistent

indicators.note: the result is produced out of the letters of the word, rearranged

explanation.surface: The most reliable performer hails from America.
explanation.definitionFit: Most stable or least variable is the superlative of steady.

clue.text: The same manner applied in this street

definitions.meaning: a single method
traffic allowed in only a single direction

explanation.surface: A council imposes identical rules on a road.
explanation.definitionFit: Literally a single method; also the term for a road with traffic in one direction only.

clue.text: Phony acts coming from a servile flatterer

indicators.note: the result is made out of the letters of the two words, reshuffled

explanation.surface: Fake behaviour reveals a crawler.
explanation.definitionFit: A toady or bootlicker who fawns on the powerful.
